landing.platformIntro: CivicSense AI connects Karnataka residents and municipal engineering departments through structured grievance reporting, transparent AI prioritization, and live spatial hotspot monitoring.
landing.fallbackDesc: Real-time pothole, water supply, drainage, streetlight, and civic asset monitoring.
landing.highlight1Desc: Automatically categorizes road, water, drainage, waste, and streetlight grievances with keyword extraction.
landing.highlight2Desc: Calculates explainable 0–100 urgency scores across safety risk, affected citizens, duplicates, and age.
landing.highlight3Desc: Supports offline PWA draft capture with automatic sync and spatial cluster tracking across districts.
landing.selectSubtitle: Choose whether you are signing in as a citizen reporting or tracking civic issues, or as an authorized government administrator.
landing.citizenDesc: Submit infrastructure complaints with GPS pinning and photos, review AI triage results, and track your complaint status.
landing.adminDesc: Restricted to provisioned municipal officials with approved official work domains to triage queues, assign crews, and inspect analytics.
landing.securityFooter: All portal sessions are protected by server-verified tokens and role permissions.

insights.title: AI Infrastructure Insights & Maintenance Recommendations
insights.methodologyDesc: Priority thresholds: Critical (80–100), High (60–79), Medium (40–59), Low (0–39). This prototype computes deterministic scores from weighted civic factors rather than a trained machine learning model.
insights.method1Desc: Infrastructure failure severity (30) + safety keywords like open manholes or live wires (25).
insights.method2Desc: Nearby geo-text duplicate matches (15) + 14-day neighborhood frequency (10).
insights.method3Desc: Estimated affected citizens (10) + pending days elapsed since reporting (10).

inspector.criticalDesc: Prioritize field isolation and barricade deployment.
inspector.rulesNote: Scores reflect deterministic weighted rules rather than a trained ML prediction.
